column1: By- Law Regarding Maintenance of Beauty Centers
THIS  is  to  notify  that  I,  Dhamma  Dissanayake,  Governor  of  the  Sabaragamuwa  Province  has  approved  the  By-law
regarding  maintenance  of  Beauty  Centers  within  authoritative  area  of  Yatiyanthota  Pradeshiya  Sabha,  prepared  by  the
Yatiyanthota Pradeshiya Sabha by virtue of powers vested in it under Section 122 read with Section 126 of Pradeshiya
Sabha  Act,  No.  15  of  1987  and  passed  at  its  General  meeting  held  on  09.07.2019,  by  virtue  of  powers  vested  under
Section 123(1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, read with Section 2 of Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No.
12  of  1989,  and  it  will  be  effective  within  authoritative  area  of  Yatiyanthota    Pradeshiya  Sabha  from  the  date  this
notification is published in the Gazette.
